CLAUDE.md:65 already reads "**Self review** — `/self-review`: a **bounded loop** of review → fix → ..." as if the command exists. `Glob('.claude/**')` and `Glob('.claude')` both return no files, and .claude is not gitignored as a whole (only `.claude/settings.local.json` is, per `.gitignore:191`).

verdict.reason: The todo file's own checklist item ("[x] `.claude/commands/self-review.md` — drives the bounded loop...") claims this file was created, and CLAUDE.md:65, CONTRIBUTING.md:185, and docs/design/agentic-dev-loop.md:57,79 all reference `/self-review` as if the command exists. I searched exhaustively: Glob('.claude/**'), Glob('.claude'), and even Glob with explicit path='.claude' (which errored "Directory does not exist") all confirm no `.claude` directory exists anywhere in the working tree. I also checked for the capability under alternate names/locations — scripts/*.md (scripts/agent/lenses/*.md, scripts/agent/charters/*.md, scripts/README.md), package.json scripts, and a repo-wide grep for "/self-review" — and found only prose references to the slash command, never the command file itself or an equivalent implementation elsewhere. This is a genuine documentation-vs-deliverable contradiction: a checkbox and multiple docs assert an artifact exists that is verifiably absent from the repository, squarely within the Docs lens's 'documentation contradicted by this PR's own code/state' category.
